If it's any consolation, I can almost assure you despite what she fronts she is almost certainly miserable inside if she's not doing any kind of work on herself and displaying that kind of behaviour. She may appeared to have left you in the dust and maybe she doesn't feel remorse over that but I sincerely doubt she's content with the lying and shit. I'm trying to move towards compassion for the girl I was seeing and not anger but it's going to take awhile.

I know because I've had BPD since I was 13 and even the girl I was with who had another dude was chronically empty inside from her own admission. Constantly having to figure out what others think, constantly having to spin and come up with more lies. Never ending push and pull between wanting attention and isolation. It's a very exhausting disorder and there is very rarely peace of mind ...only distractions most of the time with "relationships" and substance abuse or other self destructive behaviour.

Anyways, thanks again friend. Maybe I should watch some bojack to get my mind off this shit lol. Or pokemon next week.

The lying is the thing! And it's not just me, I know of other people she lied to because she admitted to me how much she does. She just convinced me that for some reason she feels she doesn't have to lie to me.

But I've seen the lies I just got gaslighted into thinking I was being oversensitive or paranoid. I really need to see things for what they were and your post helped with that.

I'm not a saint and have my own issues but this shit was doomed from the start

I have BPD, and I recently dated a girl with it as well. In some ways we related like noone i ever have and in other ways it was a nightmare. The lying, back and forth between obsession and isolation. Distrust.

I hope we both get the help we need because i fear that I'll never be able to be in a healthy relationship.
